hypothesis: a nonlinear query-group ranker trained with session-balanced emphasis on all 43 C100-reachable current misses can learn proposal corrections that the linear hard-case residual and frozen ranker fusion could not express
unique_variable: one focused depth-3 LambdaMART proposal model trained on complete allowed-91 groups; current policy remains the immutable default

focused_cache.hard_sessions: current-policy misses with target present in the allowed slot-10 set on at least one eligible turn; expected count 43
focused_cache.control_sessions: current-policy hits whose first hit has rank 10 and which expose at least one allowed target query no later than that first hit
focused_cache.hard_turns: every eligible turn with target in the allowed set
focused_cache.control_turns: eligible target-present turns up to and including current first-hit turn
focused_cache.allowed_candidates: P11 slot-10 incumbent plus C100 indices 10 through 99, exactly 91 rows per query
focused_cache.features: exact semantic-off projected query-candidate feature row; no current score/rank, identifier, fold, cohort, session, target, or future field

group_weighting.first: within each session, all selected query groups sum to base weight one
group_weighting.second: inside each actual training partition, hard and control group weights each sum to 50 percent
group_weighting.third: rescale selected group weights to mean one
group_weighting.xgboost_weight_unit: one weight per query group, never per candidate row

stage_a_outer_oof_proposal_triage.training: for outer fold o, fit only focused groups whose session outer_fold differs from o
stage_a_outer_oof_proposal_triage.scoring: score every query/candidate row only with the model that excluded its outer product-family fold

stage_b_gate.reason: must strictly expand the best closed pairwise proposal ceiling of 13 sessions rather than merely retune admission

stage_b_predeclared_only_if_stage_a_pass.ranker: five inner models plus one outer model per outer fold using the identical cache, weights, and fixed model
stage_b_predeclared_only_if_stage_a_pass.proposal: inner-OOF on outer-train for admission training; outer model on outer-train for unlabeled quantile mapping and outer-held scoring
stage_b_predeclared_only_if_stage_a_pass.supplemental_action: focused choice differs from current served choice and P11 incumbent; KEEP preserves current exactly
stage_b_predeclared_only_if_stage_a_pass.admission_features: the same eight bounded current/proposal rank and candidate-difference fields used by v2.3/v2.4, with focused semantic names
stage_b_predeclared_only_if_stage_a_pass.admission_heads: current-relative isolated rescue and composite-regret C=0.2 logistic heads with session-normalized weighted preprocessing
stage_b_predeclared_only_if_stage_a_pass.quantile_candidates: fixed 0/64 through 63/64 plus KEEP, selected inner-only
stage_b_predeclared_only_if_stage_a_pass.inner_safety: aggregate and every inner fold have zero hit-to-miss, nonnegative MRR delta, and nonpositive MTTC delta
stage_b_predeclared_only_if_stage_a_pass.promotion: HR strictly above 0.9715, zero aggregate hit-to-miss, no fold net/MRR/MTTC regression, positive TechnicalScore, exact repeat

method_boundary.ranker_stage_a_claim: strict outer product-family OOF for the newly trained focused ranker
method_boundary.future_stage_b_claim: nested focused ranker/admission conditioned on the frozen current OOF comparator, not an end-to-end nested base-policy stack
method_boundary.target_cluster_grouping_limitation: 747 exact-target families do not prove near-duplicate-family or private generalization

stop_rule: If Stage A fails either fixed proposal gate, close this exact focused LambdaMART without changing cohort, weights, tree parameters, or oracle threshold; otherwise execute the already specified nested Stage B
